title: Checked Allocation Math
prompt: Implement `checkedTotal(a,b,c)` returning `a*b*c` or nullopt on ANY intermediate overflow. The battery uses SIZE_MAX-class extremes.

tests.name: overflow extremes
tests.hint: Two steps: !__builtin_mul_overflow(a, b, &t) then !__builtin_mul_overflow(t, c, out). Multiply by zero can never overflow — let it succeed naturally.
